A model that can't agree with itself within an order of magnitude has no track record worth trusting on an OMC where the real swing factor -- circular debt and receivables -- isn't even in the inputs. Averaging over that gap, rather than flagging it as unresolved, is the omission.

house_view.summary: TA shows a confirmed, if quiet, downtrend: price below both SMA20 and SMA50 with the shorter average under the longer, on subdued volume. FA counters with a headline 17.3% discount to composite fair value, but that number averages four methods spanning a 10x range and the feed is blind to circular-debt/receivables, the real OMC swing factor. Forward P/E exceeding trailing P/E hints the market already expects softer earnings into the Aug 21 results. Layer on live Brent/Hormuz volatility (impact 4-5 news this week) and the desk sees no clean edge either way right now -- momentum says wait, valuation says cheap but on a shaky composite. No broker digest was surfaced this session.
